menu.scene: A private supper host stops a wheeled service cart halfway through the pantry door after noticing red splatter continuing from a place setting onto the white wheel. The lavish untouched last course now blocks the route used to clear the table.
At a decayed sumptuous private supper, a person pulls a clean runner across the table, and the service end exposes a bloodlike hand-wipe on the underside while the empty places remain precisely set.

A person in a private dining room turns from a bell pull toward an open service hatch; a bloodlike sprayed fan across both rooms exposes the route while a silver cloche continues to steam beside untouched dessert.

menu.scene: A host carries an immaculate dessert plate toward a single empty chair while a bloodlike splash crosses the chair, napkin and nearby service corridor; the old course is still in the hatch.
A host braces a service trolley at the dining-room threshold; the front wheel has rolled through a fresh red pool, leaving the first curved track back toward a lavish abandoned supper.
A person lowers a tray through a private dining-room service hatch; a crimson splatter fan crosses the tray and glazed hatch, and the opposite door is held open by a fallen gilt place-card stand.
